page: List of tallest buildings in Toronto

rows.text: Not a habitable building. Included for comparison purposes. Tallest free-standing structure in the world from 1976 to 2007, and tallest tower until 2009.
Currently the tallest building in Canada. Topped off in early 2026. First building in Canada over 100 storeys.
Formerly known as The One. Topped off in late 2025. Briefly the tallest building in Canada from 2025 to 2026.

Tallest building in Canada from 1975 to 2025. 8th-tallest building in the world at the time of its completion. Tallest building in the world outside Chicago and New York City at the time of its completion. Tallest building completed in Toronto in the 1970s. Formerly known as First Bank Tower.
Tallest mixed-use building in Canada. Tallest building completed in Toronto in the 2010s. Formerly known as Trump International Hotel & Tower Toronto and later as The Adelaide Hotel.
Tallest building completed in Toronto in the 1980s.
Tallest residential building in Toronto and in Canada.
Tallest building completed in Toronto in the 1990s.
Tallest building completed in Toronto in the 2020s so far.
